purpose: Characterize the task1-only 40k negative diagnostic against the already completed same-seed joint4 and mixed-batch8 evaluations without spending more GPU budget.
falsifiable_checks: For each paired task1 init 0..19, compare saved first-input provenance across runs on model arrays, simulator state, frame, input, images, processor state, and RNG; exclude loaded model weights because treatments intentionally differ.
Compute paired success discordances and exact two-sided McNemar p values only where per-init outcome records exist; treat all one-seed contrasts as descriptive, not causal.
For fixed init3, compare five outcomes and saved start provenance; do not infer deterministic replay beyond the fields and runs directly inspected.
decision_rule: If first-input provenance differs, mark that comparison not fully start-matched. Regardless, report only descriptive one-seed outcome contrasts and do not change registered gates or claim causality.
